summary.text: Larry Miner is a Republican state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 7 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Miner appeared on the Republican primary ballot for Rockingham 32 in 2022, when he lost to incumbent Josh Yokela.
In 2024 he defeated incumbent Josh Yokela and Kalup Veneman in the Republican primary for Rockingham 7 and won the general election on November 5, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, defeating Emily Phillips, and is on the general election ballot against JJ DeFeo (D).
